title: Prasun language - Wikipedia
text: Prasun is a Nuristani language spoken in the Prasun Valley in Afghanistan. Prasun belongs to the Indo-European language family, and is on the Nuristani group of the Indo-Iranian branch. Prasun is considered as the most divergent of the Nuristani languages.
